description: Unit test class for the DefaultEffectedSubjects class, verifying immutability, equality, null handling, and getter methods with unmodifiable sets.

classes.name: DefaultEffectedSubjectsTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for DefaultEffectedSubjects, testing immutability, equality, null input handling, and unmodifiable set behavior.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Asserts that DefaultEffectedSubjects instances are immutable and their fields are correctly safe-copied and unmodifiable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullGranted
methods.description: Tests that passing null for granted subjects throws NullPointerException with appropriate message.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullRevoked
methods.description: Tests that passing null for revoked subjects throws NullPointerException with appropriate message.

methods.name: getGrantedReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getGranted() returns the expected set of authorized subjects.

methods.name: getGrantedReturnsUnmodifiableSet
methods.description: Ensures that the set returned by getGranted() is unmodifiable.

methods.name: getRevokedReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getRevoked() returns the expected set of revoked subjects.

methods.name: getRevokedReturnsUnmodifiableSet
methods.description: Ensures that the set returned by getRevoked() is unmodifiable.
